data.summary:
Savant AI is designed to assist users by providing accurate information, answering questions, and offering guidance across a wide range of topics. Its purpose is to enhance user experience through intelligent interaction and support.

As for its current architecture, Savant AI typically employs a transformer-based model, which facilitates natural language understanding and generation. This architecture leverages vast amounts of training data, enabling it to comprehend context, maintain coherence in conversations, and deliver relevant responses. The model is designed to continuously learn and adapt, improving its performance over time based on user interactions.
